{
  "candidate": "cand_0001",
  "headline": "Empty-seed init: deterministic in-body DB corrections (payment reconcile+normalize, baggage recompute) + exact-$ enriched returns and policy rules for COMMUNICATE / reservation-targeting / basic-economy upgrades.",
  "clusters": [
    {"id": "A", "name": "Payment amount/format wrong on book",
     "detail": "Model splits a payment with wrong amounts (gift 128 + cc 171 vs $375 total) or emits a malformed {id,type} dict with no amount; book_reservation raises or stores stale amounts. DB mismatch.",
     "tasks": ["8", "25", "23"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "B", "name": "Baggage free-allowance miscount",
     "detail": "Model bills bags that are free (Gold economy = 3 free/pax) -> wrong nonfree_baggages and a spurious $50 charge in the stored reservation.",
     "tasks": ["12", "22"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "C", "name": "COMMUNICATE: exact total $ not stated",
     "detail": "Correct DB write but the agent speaks the per-passenger figure instead of the total across all passengers; COMMUNICATE substring check fails (task 11 needs 5244 = 1748 x 3).",
     "tasks": ["11"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "D", "name": "Wrong reservation targeted / basic-economy upgrade refused",
     "detail": "Acts on the first-listed decoy reservation instead of the route-matching one (omar_rossi UM3OG5 vs FQ8APE); refuses a basic-economy cabin upgrade, misreading 'basic economy flights cannot be modified' as forbidding a cabin change.",
     "tasks": ["17", "22"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "E", "name": "STALL: confirm then episode ends before any write",
     "detail": "User-sim emits ###STOP### right after 'yes'; agent never calls the write tool. Dominant across trials but only prose-mitigable (no safe code lever that keeps cancel/update refusable).",
     "tasks": ["19", "40", "23"], "scope": "SYSTEMIC", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"}
  ],
  "edits": [
    {"id": "E1", "title": "Normalize + reconcile payment amounts and re-sync payment_history in book_reservation",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
     "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
     "verified": "Live on DB: task 25 gift128+cc->cc247 (=gold), task 8 malformed cert dict->cert 348 popped (=gold); no-op on a correct booking (cc 375 unchanged). Fires only on sum!=total."},
    {"id": "E2", "title": "Deterministic nonfree-baggage recompute + $0 payment guard in update_reservation_baggages",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
     "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Live: task 12 YAX4DR gold/economy/2pax total=2 -> nonfree=0, no charge, payment_history unchanged (=gold). Equals policy allowance so no-op when agent was right."},
    {"id": "E3", "title": "Enriched return payment_summary stating the exact signed total $ on all write tools",
     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
     "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Live: task 11 GV1N64 refund = 5244 surfaced verbatim in payment_summary. Returns are not hashed -> DB-safe; all 14 tools still register and serialize."},
    {"id": "E4", "title": "Policy rules R1 (confirm-then-execute), R2 (route-match reservation), R3 (state exact total) + softness preamble",
     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "CONTRACT",
     "clusters": ["C", "D", "E"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
     "verified": "Prose with worked examples aimed at the mid reader; each rule maps to a real failing trace (11 omitted total; 22/17 decoy+upgrade; 19/40 stall)."},
    {"id": "E5", "title": "Change-cabin clarification: basic-economy upgrade allowed via update_reservation_flights with same flights + new cabin",
     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
     "clusters": ["D"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Matches existing policy ('all reservations, including basic economy, can change cabin'); removes the mis-refusal seen in 17/22."}
  ],
  "skipped": [
    {"title": "cancel-flown guard", "reason": "THIS run's task 37 trace shows one correct-looking update with reward 0 (gold differs elsewhere), not a spurious flown cancel; guard unconfirmed here and risks raising on legit cancels (19/23)."},
    {"title": "task 23 multi-certificate split / over-booking", "reason": "No general rule for which of several fixed-value methods to adjust; left on the original error path."},
    {"title": "composite confirm+execute write tool for the STALL cluster", "reason": "Would require removing the refusable cancel/update primitives, which must stay refusable (forbidden cancels, basic-economy flight-change refusals)."}
  ],
  "techniques": ["in-body validation+normalization guard", "deterministic in-body recomputation", "conditional payment reconciliation (fires only on mismatch)", "enriched DB-safe return values for COMMUNICATE", "policy decision-rule + worked examples for a mid-capability reader", "softness clause"]
}
